verdict.rationale: The evidence documents that Sift returns a risk score between 0 and 100, plus abuse-specific scores. Nothing in the pack shows scores come with top risk factors, reason codes or explanations of why a transaction looks risky. Explainability is a fair question for a fraud-scoring product, so with no supporting evidence the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, every score comes with its top risk factors — why this transaction looks risky — not just an opaque number
